== Biography ==
In 1977, he graduated with a degree in mathematics from the [[:pl:Wydział Podstawowych Problemów Techniki Politechniki Wrocławskiej|Faculty of Fundamental Problems of Technology]] of [[Wrocław University of Science and Technology]] in [[Wrocław]]. He was a PhD student at the Institute of Mathematics at the Wroclaw University of Technology from 1977 to 1981, where he obtained his doctorate in 1981 based on the dissertation ''On zero sum stochastic games with general state space,''  written under the supervision of [[Rastislav Telgarsky]].<ref name="PhDPWr_ASN">{{Cite thesis |title=On zero sum stochastic games with general state space |degree=PhD |publisher=Wrocław University of Technology |year=1981
|access-date=2024-10-16 |author=Andrzej S. Nowak |url=https://dona.pwr.edu.pl/szukaj/default.aspx?nrsys=49909}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|access-date=2025-01-20 |author=Marian Hotloś |date=2018 |editor=Henryk Kasprzak, Ryszard Poprawski |isbn=978-83-7977-340-4 |location=Wrocław |pages=173–175 |publisher=Oficyna Wydawnicza Atut - Wrocławskie Wydawnictwo Oświatowe |title=50 lat Wydziału Podstawowych Problemów Techniki Politechniki Wrocławskiej 1968-2018: księga jubileuszowa |website=Politechnika Wrocławska|url=https://www.atutoficyna.pl/szukaj?func=productPage&wid=57&pid=945&cid=0&prid=#&gid=gallery1&pid=1}}</ref><ref name="MGP_ASN">{{cite web|access-date=2022-10-14 |title=Andrzej Nowak – The Mathematics Genealogy Project |url=https://www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu/id.php?id=69161 |website=www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu}}<!-- auto-translated from Polish by Module:CS1 translator --></ref> In 1993, he defended the dissertation at [[:pl:Wydział Matematyki i Informatyki Uniwersytetu Wrocławskiego|Faculty of Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry]], [[Wrocław University]], based on the work ''Optimal and equilibrium strategies in stochastic games.''<ref name="habUWr">{{Cite web |title=Zespół Uniwersytet Wrocławski po 1945 roku. Wydział Matematyki, Fizyki i Chemii; Wydział Matematyki i Fizyki, Wydział Matematyki i Informatyki, Wydział Chemii, Wydział Fizyki i Astronomii. Wykaz habilitacji za lata 1945–2015 |trans-title=List of habilitations for the years 1945–2015: Faculty of Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry; Faculty of Mathematics and Physics, Faculty of Mathematics and Computer Science, Faculty of Chemistry, Faculty of Physics and Astronomy |publisher=University of Wrocław |quote=Poz. 240: Andrzej Nowak. Temat rozprawy: Strategie optymalne i równowagi w grach stochastycznych. Data uchwały: 19 października 1993. Dyscyplina: matematyka |url=https://archiw.uwr.edu.pl/wp-content/uploads/sites/114/2023/01/hab_matfizchem_1945-2015.pdf |language=pl |access-date=2024-10-16}}</ref>

After earning his doctoral degree in mathematics on 24 June 1981, he was employed as an assistant professor at the Institute of Mathematics and Computer Science at Wrocław University of Technology until 30 September 1999. After that, he moved to the Faculty of Mathematics  at the [[University of Zielona Góra]], where he has been affiliated with the Faculty of Mathematics, heading the Division of Mathematical Economics and Optimization from 2008 to 2016. In 2004, he was appointed professor of mathematics.{{r|NNPolska}}{{r|NPolska}}<ref>{{cite web|access-date=2025-01-20 |title=Forum Akademickie |url=https://forumakademickie.pl/media/archiwum/2004/05/02-kronika.htm |website=forumakademickie.pl}}<!-- auto-translated from Polish by Module:CS1 translator --></ref><ref>{{Cite web |author=Dorota Krassowska |title=Tytuły profesorskie: najnowsze nominacje naszych pracowników |publisher=Uniwersytet Zielonogórski - Miesięcznik Społeczności Akademickiej |date=May 2004 |access-date=2025-01-20 |url=http://miesiecznik.uz.zgora.pl/wydawnictwo/miesiecznik04-2004/06.pdf}}</ref> He also served as the Head of Department of Finance at Faculty of Economic Sciences of [[University of Applied Sciences]] in [[Nysa, Poland]].

== Contributions ==
His research articles can be found in [[Annals of Probability]], [[Mathematics of Operations Research]], [[Society for Industrial and Applied Mathematics#Publications|SIAM Journal of Control and Optimization]], [[Games and Economic Behavior]], [[Journal of Economic Theory]], [[Automatica]].  References to his papers can be found in mathematical databases.<ref name=MathSciNet>{{cite web | url=https://mathscinet.ams.org/mathscinet/MRAuthorID/850256 | title=List of publications in MathSciNet | author=Andrzej S. Nowak | year=1977 | publisher=American Mathematical Society | language =en | access-date=2021-02-19}}</ref><ref name=StTrZBL>{{cite web | url=https://zbmath.org/authors/nowak.andrzej-s | title=List of publications in zbMATH | author=Andrzej S. Nowak | year=1972 |publisher=FIZ Karlsruhe GmbH | language=en  | access-date=2021-02-19}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=ORCID |url=https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0314-0901 |access-date=2025-01-22 |website=orcid.org}}</ref> His most frequently cited works deal with stochastic games<ref>{{Cite journal 
|last=Nowak |first=A. S. |last2=Raghavan |first2=T. E. S. |date=1992 |title=Existence of Stationary Correlated Equilibria with Symmetric Information for Discounted Stochastic Games |url=https://pubsonline.informs.org/doi/10.1287/moor.17.3.519 |journal=Mathematics of Operations Research |language=en |volume=17 |issue=3 |pages=519–526 |doi=10.1287/moor.17.3.519 
|issn=0364-765X|url-access=subscription }}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal 
|last=Nowak |first=Andrzej S. |date=2003 |title=On a new class of nonzero-sum discounted stochastic games having stationary Nash equilibrium points |url=http://link.springer.com/10.1007/s001820200118 |journal=International Journal of Game Theory |volume=32 |issue=1 |pages=121–132 |doi=10.1007/s001820200118 |issn=0020-7276|url-access=subscription }}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal |last=Nowak |first=Andrzej S. |date=1985 |title=Measurable Selection Theorems for Minimax Stochastic Optimization Problems |url=http://epubs.siam.org/doi/10.1137/0323030 |journal=SIAM Journal on Control and Optimization |language=en |volume=23 |issue=3 |pages=466–476 |doi=10.1137/0323030 
|issn=0363-0129|url-access=subscription }}</ref> and cooperative games.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Nowak |first=Andrzej S. |date=1997 |title=On an axiomatization of the Banzhaf value without the additivity axiom |url=https://doi.org/10.1007/bf01262517 |journal=International Journal of Game Theory |volume=26 |issue=1 |pages=137–141 |doi=10.1007/bf01262517 |issn=0020-7276|url-access=subscription }}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal 
|last=Nowak |first=Andrzej S. |last2=Radzik |first2=Tadeusz |date=1994 |title=A solidarity value forn-person transferable utility games |url=http://link.springer.com/10.1007/BF01242845 |journal=International Journal of Game Theory |language=en |volume=23 |issue=1 |pages=43–48 |doi=10.1007/BF01242845 |issn=0020-7276|url-access=subscription }}</ref>

His editorial activities include participation on the editorial board of the journals: [[International Society of Dynamic Games#ISDG publications|Dynamic Games and Applications]], [[International Society of Dynamic Games#ISDG publications|International Journal of Game Theory]] (2001–2008), [[:de:Mathematical Methods of Operations Research|Mathematical Methods of Operations Research]] (2006–2008).

He was the advisor of 3 PhD theses: [[Anna Jaśkiewicz]],<ref>{{Cite web |title=Nominacja profesorska prof. Anny Jaśkiewicz |url=https://wmat.pwr.edu.pl/o-wydziale/aktualnosci/nominacja-profesorska-prof-anny-jaskiewicz-11107.html |access-date=2025-12-04 |website=wmat.pwr.edu.pl |language=pl}}</ref> Piotr Szajowski, Łukasz Balbus.{{r|PhDPWr_ASN}}{{r|MGP_ASN}}

He is the member of the [[International Society of Dynamic Games]]. In 2007–2011 he was a member of  the [[:pl:Komitety Polskiej Akademii Nauk|Mathematical Committee]] of the  [[Polish Academy of Sciences]].

He became the recipient of [[International Society of Dynamic Games#The Isaacs Award|The Isaacs Award]] (2018)<ref name=ASNinMA>{{cite journal |last1=Jaśkiewicz |first1=Anna |title=Interview with Andrzej Nowak-Laureate of the Rufus Isaacs Award |journal=Mathematica Applicanda. Annales Societatis Mathematicae Polonae, Series III |date=2019 |volume=47 |issue=1 |pages=61–80 |doi=10.14708/ma.v47i1.6491 |url=https://wydawnictwa.ptm.org.pl/index.php/matematyka-stosowana/article/view/6491| access-date=2025-01-15 |issn=2299-4009|url-access=subscription }}</ref>  and recognized Distinguish alumni of Wrocław University of Science and Technology.<ref name="DisAlumniPWr">{{cite web|title=List of WPPT laureates honored with the "Distinguished Alumni of PWr" badge|date=2009|access-date=2025-01-20|url=https://wppt.pwr.edu.pl/o-wydziale/wyroznieni-absolwenci}}</ref>
